name: Oyo’s court in exile

summary.text: Around 1535 the Nupe sacked Oyo-Ile and the ruling house fled, first to Borgu and then to a capital in exile at Igboho. For some eighty years Oyo was an exiled dynasty, until Alaafin Abipa brought the court home in the early 17th century.

routes.label: The court flees to Borgu, then settles at Igboho
Alaafin Abipa returns the court to Oyo-Ile

moments.title: Oyo-Ile sacked
moments.text: The Nupe take and sack the capital.

moments.title: Igboho, the capital in exile
moments.text: Igboho serves as the capital for the exiled dynasty; tradition says four Alaafin are buried there.
